description: Defines IPC message handling classes and templates, including ScalarType specializations, Text, BufferType, and related utilities within the WPEFramework Core IPC namespace.

classes.name: ScalarType
classes.description: Template class for scalar data types, with specialization for string type.

classes.name: ScalarType<string>
classes.description: Specialization of ScalarType for string, providing serialization and deserialization methods.

classes.name: Text
classes.description: Template class for fixed-length text strings with serialization support.

classes.name: BufferType
classes.description: Template class for buffer handling, wrapping Core::FrameType with serialization and deserialization.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator for ScalarType and Text classes.

methods.name: Value
methods.description: Getter and setter for ScalarType data.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns length of Text or ScalarType data.
